issues.title: Misplaced list markers in RTL
issues.description: List bullet markers render at the trailing end of lines instead of leading each item.
issues.evidence: Bulleted items in the assistant panel show dots attached to the rightmost text edges.
issues.suggestion: Set proper list-style direction and margin mirroring for RTL items.
issues.triageNote: Playwright DOM measurement of /eval/pair-150 proves the marker renders at the LEADING edge: log row dir=rtl, dot x=974 vs paragraph x-range 701-964 with text-align:start, chevron x=969 (start side) — flexbox mirrors natively, no physical position utilities exist in the log lines; the auditor read the correct RTL-leading (rightmost) dots as 'trailing' using LTR reasoning. Hardening applied anyway: swapped the component's lone physical utility text-left -> text-start (zero visual change).

issues.title: Low text contrast on inactive log items
issues.description: The pending step description text has insufficient contrast against the card background.
issues.evidence: 'Waiting on the tuning sliders before applying anything' is barely legible against the dark surface.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text color luminance for muted state entries.
issues.triageNote: Measured on /eval/pair-089: 'done' log text rgb(85,82,76) on the dark card = 2.53:1 and the flagged active line 'Waiting on the tuning sliders...' rgb(42,41,38) = 1.35:1 (near-invisible) — the LogLine pattern authored in ThoughtHeader's demo hardcodes light-theme neutrals (text-neutral-400/-200, bg-neutral-900) that invert to near-black in dark theme. Fixed the demo pattern with dark: counterparts (canvas dark:bg-neutral-100, done text dark:text-neutral-600, active dark:text-neutral-700, dots dark:bg-neutral-500/600) and fixed the component's own inverted neutrals (border-neutral-800 divider rendered near-white at 13.97:1 in dark -> border-default-border; hover:text-neutral-300 / group-hover:text-neutral-400 darkened on hover in dark -> added dark: counterparts). Note: /eval/pair-089 renders its own local LogLine copy (outside my edit scope), so that page's log pixels persist; the pattern source and the component itself are fixed.
